say:1:1033606001:1.text: Yes, Captain Parisa has designated spots in the forest just for that.
say:1:1033606001:1.source_cn: 是的，帕瑞莎队长在丛林里划归了不少地方用来安置难民。
say:1:1033606001:1.male: Yes, Captain Parisa has designated spots in the forest just for that.
say:1:1033606001:1.female: Yes, Captain Parisa has designated spots in the forest just for that.

say:2:1033606002:1.text: This used to be a village, but the corruption messed things up for the locals...
say:2:1033606002:1.source_cn: 这里之前是一座村庄，但因为腐化的影响，这里的村民都……
say:2:1033606002:1.male: This used to be a village, but the corruption messed things up for the locals...
say:2:1033606002:1.female: This used to be a village, but the corruption messed things up for the locals...

say:3:1033606003:1.text: A village needs residents to thrive; giving refugees a place to stay is a good decision. Plus, Wilders who got displaced by the corruption can stay here temporarily.
say:3:1033606003:1.source_cn: 村庄需要有人居住才能长久存在，用来安置难民确实是个不错...
say:3:1033606003:1.male: A village needs residents to thrive; giving refugees a place to stay is a good decision. Plus, Wilders who got displaced by the corruption can stay here temporarily.
say:3:1033606003:1.female: A village needs residents to thrive; giving refugees a place to stay is a good decision. Plus, Wilders who got displaced by the corruption can stay here temporarily.
